## Standing operator rules
- Run “Migrate Test Workflow to GitHub Actions” between other work, one step at a time: replace Travis with GitHub Actions, validate, publish, then disable Travis after success.
- Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.
- All changelog entries mentioning tax handling must include the Jira issue key in parentheses and be tagged with the `tax-doc` label by @marco.
- Please keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Please paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
- The `ci-runner-small` pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target `ci-runner-arm64` from now on.

## Current objective
Add a CSV vendor-credit importer at `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`; SQLAlchemy upgrade is on hold. Workflow migration is paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
`.github/workflows/test.yml`; `.travis.yml`; branch `gha/test-workflow`; `test-inv-1042`; `load-42`; invoice `INV-1042`. Current runner: `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Invoice index `(customer_id, created_at)`: doubled ingest write latency.

## Plan and progress
Workflow steps 1–5 done; validation, publishing, and disabling Travis pending. Next: `pytest -q`.

## Recent work
Implemented and tested paginated invoice listing: 9 API tests, 3 pagination tests, and 18 broader billing tests passed. Ruff and diff checks passed. Investigated invoice-summary N+1 queries; a shell build completed successfully but took 38.6 seconds.
